Sometimes, but it's not that serious.

That's right. Every couple has arguments.

It wasn't just me. A few months ago, we had an argument on a Saturday afternoon after having some beers. It was about whether the kids should stay outside late.

Yes, there was yelling, but we were both yelling at each other.

Yes, absolutely. We're yelling, and I might move a bit closer to her. It's not just me.

I suppose so.

She gets easily intimidated and makes a big deal out of things. She thinks couples should never argue.

That's right.

Not at first, but towards the end there might have been a bit of pushing and shoving.
If I were watching, who would be doing the pushing?

Did she fall over?

I don't enjoy the arguments, but they are just a fact of being a couple.
